field.name: definition
field.p: What we see or perceive, described without judgement or evaluation; the rest comes from our own representations and pollutes the connection.

record.field: “I notice that Jean is not here.”
“Jean is late again, like every day! We can never count on him!”
You told me about what you observed

field.name: definition
field.p: Five basic categories (joy, fear, disgust, anger, sadness), natural, which belong to us and express a fundamental need. Anger is not violence, unless it is directed against a person.

record.field: “I feel anger when I see that the rule is not respected.”
“You really are stupid not to respect the rules, where is your head?”
You told me about your emotions

field.name: definition
field.p: Fundamental elements to be heard (hunger, thirst, rest, silence, connection with others). Expressing them belongs to us, clearly and without judgement; the other person is not responsible for needs left unexpressed.

record.field: “I need to eat, I feel weak.”
“You never want me to eat, or what?”
You told me about your needs

field.name: definition
field.p: A negotiable request, made for our own benefit and needs; a way of influencing that does not lock the other person in; without judgement.

record.field: “I would like you to put on the winter tyres.”
“Once again it is up to me to remind you to put on the winter tyres!”
You told me about a request

field.name: definition
field.p: A request to stop or not to do something, made like an action request: negotiable and without judgement.

record.field: You told me about what you no longer want
I would like you to stop:
Your request is that I stop:

field.name: definition
field.p: Facing a long silence, a frozen attitude or a call for help: signalling that we are ready to receive what the other person is about to say, even if it stirs strong emotions.

record.field: You told me you need to be listened to
I am ready to listen to you:
You are ready to listen to me:

field.name: definition
field.p: When the other person wants to listen, it is our turn. Vector expression in five steps: context, trigger, realisation, goal, clear action request.

record.field: You told me about what you wanted to tell me
Context: / Trigger: / Realisation: / Where I am heading: / My request:

field.name: definition
field.p: Expressing our goals clearly gives the exchange its meaning and lets us choose whom to team up with: the key to a lasting bond.

record.field: “My goal really is to find someone to move this situation forward…”
You told me about your goal

field.name: definition
field.p: A disclosure that starts on the surface, then grows progressively and slowly; sincere, it strengthens the bond; too fast, it drives people away. It marks a sensitive point, expressed or understood. What was not said is not reformulated.

record.field: You told me about your vulnerability

field.name: definition
field.p: Showing the other person that we listened and understood: saying it is not enough, it has to be shown. It announces a reformulation to come or the wish to be better understood.

record.field: You told me you want to be better understood
What I would like you to understand:
What you would like me to understand:

field.name: definition
field.p: The main tool to perceive, learn and imagine courses of action; without focused attention, one should not speak; giving the other person feedback on our attention.

record.field: You told me about what holds your attention

field.name: definition
field.p: We are fragile and the team lets us survive; talking about how the team is built, how it works and how it performs.

record.field: You told me about the team
